tools.name: inspect_usb_slots
tools.description: Inspect visible USB slots and report a usable slot handle.

tools.name: insert_pen_drive_into_slot
tools.description: Insert the target pen drive into a previously observed USB slot.

slot_handle.description: Opaque handle for the visible USB slot that will receive the pen drive.

tools.name: open_windows_explorer
tools.description: Open Windows Explorer and report the Explorer window handle.

tools.name: inspect_explorer_removable_drives
tools.description: Inspect Explorer's removable-drive listing for the connected pen drive.

explorer_handle.description: Opaque handle for the visible Windows Explorer window to inspect.

device_session_handle.description: Opaque handle for the connected pen-drive session to match against Explorer.

tools.name: open_start_search
tools.description: Open the Windows Start search surface and report its handle.

tools.name: search_start_for_registry_editor
tools.description: Search Start for Registry Editor and report the visible program result handle.

search_surface_handle.description: Opaque handle for the Start search surface where the query is entered.

query.description: Program name to search for in Start; the allowed value is the Registry Editor executable.

tools.name: launch_registry_editor_from_result
tools.description: Launch Registry Editor from a visible Start search result.

program_result_handle.description: Opaque handle for the visible regedit.exe search result to open.

tools.name: observe_restart_status
tools.description: Read whether Windows currently shows a pending restart state.

tools.name: open_drive_context_menu
tools.description: Open the context menu for a discovered Explorer drive entry.

explorer_handle.description: Opaque handle for the Explorer window that contains the drive entry.

drive_handle.description: Opaque handle for the discovered target pen-drive entry to right-click.

tools.name: choose_format_menu_item
tools.description: Choose the Format item from a visible drive context menu.

context_menu_handle.description: Opaque handle for the visible context menu opened on the pen drive.

tools.name: set_format_dialog_options
tools.description: Set available formatting choices in the open Format dialog.

format_dialog_handle.description: Opaque handle for the open Format dialog to configure.

allocation_size.description: Allocation-size choice shown in the Format dialog; the allowed value selects the default allocation size.

format_type.description: Format-type choice shown in the Format dialog; the allowed value selects quick format.

profile_evidence_ref.description: Evidence reference returned by the current Format dialog profile observation.

tools.name: start_format_from_dialog
tools.description: Press Start in the configured Format dialog and report the visible result.

format_dialog_handle.description: Opaque handle for the configured Format dialog whose Start button will be pressed.

tools.name: open_storage_device_policy_view
tools.description: Navigate Registry Editor to the public StorageDevicePolicies view.

registry_window_handle.description: Opaque handle for the visible Registry Editor window to navigate.

location_choice.description: Registry policy location to open; the allowed value is the public StorageDevicePolicies scope.

tools.name: inspect_storage_policy_values
tools.description: Read the StorageDevicePolicies right-pane WriteProtect status.

registry_path_handle.description: Opaque handle for the open StorageDevicePolicies registry view to inspect.

tools.name: set_write_protect_policy_inactive
tools.description: Set the visible WriteProtect DWORD data in the currently open StorageDevicePolicies value view.

registry_path_handle.description: Opaque handle for the observed StorageDevicePolicies value view to edit.

new_value_data.description: DWORD data to save for WriteProtect; zero means inactive.

format_error_code.description: Visible format error code that justifies the write-protection recovery edit.

tools.name: close_registry_editor
tools.description: Close the visible Registry Editor window after policy work.

registry_window_handle.description: Opaque handle for the Registry Editor window to close.

tools.name: restart_computer_to_apply_policy
tools.description: Restart Windows to apply a pending policy change and return to the desktop.

activation_evidence_ref.description: Activation mode returned by the current policy status observation.

tools.name: observe_format_status_and_drive
tools.description: Read the visible final formatting and drive-protection status.

tools.name: inspect_format_profile_options
tools.description: Inspect the open Format dialog and report its currently supported profile choices.

format_dialog_handle.description: Opaque handle for the visible Format dialog to inspect.

tools.name: create_storage_policy_value
tools.description: Create a missing StorageDevicePolicies WriteProtect DWORD with the supplied visible value data.

registry_window_handle.description: Opaque handle for the open Registry Editor window.

policy_lookup_error_code.description: Visible code returned when the requested policy view was absent.

format_error_code.description: Visible code from the blocked Format operation.

tools.name: load_format_profile
tools.description: Load a profile that is visibly offered by the open Format dialog.

tools.name: inspect_policy_activation_options
tools.description: Inspect the visible activation options for a pending policy change.

tools.name: refresh_removable_storage_session
tools.description: Refresh the removable-storage session when that activation option is visible.

activation_evidence_ref.description: Activation mode returned by the current policy status observation.
